component.name: ST Reborn
component.summary: Revive Bose SoundTouch speakers without the Bose cloud

description.p: Bose shut down the SoundTouch cloud in May 2026, and SoundTouch speakers lost their internet radio, presets and remote control with it. ST Reborn brings them back, with no Bose cloud involved.

ul.li: Internet radio from a directory of thousands of stations
The six preset keys on the speaker and the remote work again
Spotify, music from your own media server, and groups of speakers
Installs a small agent onto your speakers over your home network

description.p: ST Reborn is an unofficial, community-built project. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by or authorized by Bose. SoundTouch and Bose are registered trademarks of Bose Corporation.
